name: fly
description: Deploys the Tovu server itself to fly.io: one machine only (SQLite), secrets never in fly.toml, deploying ships code, not content. Contributes Fly operations, server config generation and the FlyV1 credential scheme.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Puts the Tovu server itself online on Fly.io.

credentialCards.title: Connect Fly.io
credentialCards.label: fly.io
credentialCards.intro: Connect Fly.io to inspect and deploy the Tovu server and manage its Machines.
credentialCards.keyHint: Use a deploy token scoped to this app. Use an org-scoped token only when creating or managing apps across that organization. In the Fly dashboard, select the app or organization, then Tokens. Avoid the short-lived login auth token.
